en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large, open parade ground bordered by simple wooden fencing, surrounded by multi‑storey rectangular buildings with many windows and shutters. Some small groups of people and possibly soldiers are visible near the buildings. In the background there are low hills or mountains. Printed red text at the top identifies the location, and there is a short handwritten note in pen near the top left.
